The four JSON files here are test fixtures of another project, copied unchanged from
[pylutron-caseta](https://github.com/gurumitts/pylutron-caseta)'s `tests/responses`, which
is under the Apache License 2.0; [LICENSE](LICENSE) here is that license, for these four
files and nothing else in this repository. That project does not say how they were made.
Ten of the eleven serial numbers are placeholders (1234, 2345 and the like) and the
project identifier in its `tests/responses/project.json`, a file not copied here, is all
zeros, but one device, `/device/9`, carries a serial that reads as real: more likely a
bridge's answers edited than written by hand. They are test data: the shapes this
package's types are checked against.
